mapper.insert: INSERT INTO restaurant ( user_id, village_id, name, business_start_time, business_end_time, logo_url, address, coordinate_lat, coordinate_lng, phone, notice, license_urls, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{villageId}, #{name}, #{businessStartTime}, #{businessEndTime}, #{logoUrl}, #{address}, #{coordinateLat}, #{coordinateLng}, #{phone}, #{notice}, #{licenseUrls}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE restaurant SET user_id = #{userId}, village_id = #{villageId}, name = #{name}, business_start_time = #{businessStartTime}, business_end_time = #{businessEndTime}, logo_url = #{logoUrl}, address = #{address}, coordinate_lat = #{coordinateLat}, coordinate_lng = #{coordinateLng}, phone = #{phone}, notice = #{notice}, license_urls = #{licenseUrls}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM restaurant WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
